notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon. Piece: seven-metres-at-sea-level (text only; audio at 474 MB, over the 400 MB cap). Numbers come from a standard-atmosphere and siphon-loss script (55.1 kPa, a 5.62 m column, crest absolute = 5.62 - lift - 0.40) and a day-by-day drawdown run. An adversarial re-read caught a freeboard contradiction (deepening the notch would undo the department's 4 m of freeboard), fixed by refilling the trench over the pipes; a six-pipes-hold-the-level error (inflow is only 20 L/s), fixed to one pipe with nine drained; and readings that had drifted from the model (ice-night drawdown rate, step survey heights). Verification: node --test 15/15 in ventures/hearth-and-horizon; post frontmatter, link and similarity checks pass. No agent doc in docs/reports: nothing the next run needs beyond DONE.md and the story's note.
